title: Spring Boot Docker image trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for spring-boot-docker-image trace events.

tag.description: Tag of the image currently being built, pushed or run; empty before the first build.

context.description: The build context: the folder `docker build .` sends to the daemon.

totalMb.description: Size of the whole project folder in MB.

sentMb.description: Size actually transferred, i.e. minus what .dockerignore excludes.

entries.description: Top-level entries of the project folder.

ignored.description: Whether .dockerignore keeps this entry out of the context.

stages.description: Names of the Dockerfile's stages, in order; the last one becomes the image.

layers.description: Layers of the most recent build (or of the image being pushed/run), bottom first.

id.description: Layer id within this build, e.g. L3 — used by `highlight`.

instruction.description: The Dockerfile line that produced this layer, untranslated.

sizeMb.description: Bytes the layer adds to the image, in MB; 0 for metadata instructions.

status.description: Whether the daemon wrote this layer or reused it from the build cache.

metadata.description: True for WORKDIR/ENV/EXPOSE/USER/ENTRYPOINT, which add no bytes.

stage.description: Name of the build stage this layer belongs to.

inFinalImage.description: False for layers of a discarded stage of a multi-stage build.

image.description: The image the last build produced; null before the first build finishes.

sizeMb.description: Total size of the final stage's layers in MB.

user.description: Account PID 1 runs as; 'root' when the Dockerfile has no USER.

entrypoint.description: The command the container starts, untranslated.

push.description: Result of the most recent `docker push`.

pushed.description: Whether a push has happened for the current image.

uploadedMb.description: MB of layers the registry did not have yet.

skippedMb.description: MB of layers the registry already stored.

container.description: The running container, or null while nothing has been run.

user.description: Account PID 1 runs as inside the container.

memoryLimitMb.description: The container memory limit passed to `docker run -m`.

heapMb.description: Max heap the JVM takes from that limit.

heapPercent.description: MaxRAMPercentage in effect: 25 by default, or what the image sets.

stats.description: Running totals across the whole session.

layersBuilt.description: Layers the daemon had to write.

layersCached.description: Layers taken from the build cache.

contextSentMb.description: MB of build context transferred across all builds.

contextSavedMb.description: MB .dockerignore kept out across all builds.

uploadedMb.description: MB pushed to the registry across all pushes.

skippedMb.description: MB skipped on push because the registry already had those layers.
